data.name: Ezalm : Magic's Memory
data.detailed_description:
A narrative-driven action RPG where your combat style depends on the elemental magic you choose. Lost in a forgotten region, unravel the mysteries of ancient peoples to find your way back to Ezalm.

Embody your fighting style:

Follow the assassin’s path to isolate your targets, choose the guardian’s path to absorb damage, embrace the mage’s path to unleash devastating spells… or combine them!

  • 6 paths to choose from and over a hundred possible combinations!

  • Choose from a selection of offensive and defensive spells, combat arts and amulets to define your fighting style.

  • Each of the elemental magics has its counterpart. Adapt your fighting style to make the most of this.

  • Be flexible and adapt to your enemies’ strategies.

A journey through the land of your ancestors:

Decades had passed since humans were forced to abandon Sunderu, their ancestral homeland, to escape an invasion of creatures that had emerged from nowhere. But the peace they had hoped to find across the seas was short-lived, and the attacks struck the cities once again.

Freya is a formidable and experienced warrior as well as one of the defenders of the village of Ezalm, even though she is unable to use magic following an accident that occurred when she was young.

Her fate takes a dramatic turn the day she wakes up alone and, inexplicably, in Sunderu. As she travels through this unfamiliar land, she discovers a seyerite crystal that reawakens the power that lay dormant within her. Guided by this newly awakened magic, Freya then embarks on a perilous journey to find her way back to Ezalm.

Her journey will lead her to encounter forgotten peoples, uncover the buried secrets of her world, and defy the very forces of nature.

But as the truth unfolds, one question remains:

How far are we willing to go to sacrifice the balance of the world in order to get back home?

Adjust the difficulty to suit your preferences:

A game for everyone, whether you’re a fan of combat or exploration, or simply looking to get away from it all.

  • Choose from the three pre-set difficulty levels or set your own.

  • Check the combat log for specific advice on your fighting style.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Window 10 64 bits
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 4700 U | Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7500U
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon Graphics | NVIDIA GeForce 940MX
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11
